acceptance.gate: Phase 4 gate G4 per master-plan v2.1 §9: sigma_yy(D) = 50 reference, within 4% (Coreform 2.99%).

boundary_conditions.multi_cell_part: two cells of one part with different Abaqus material sections; displacement continuous, thermal expansion discontinuous
boundary_conditions.probe: sigma_yy sampled at D on the surrounding-material side of the interface
boundary_conditions.symmetry: u_x = 0 on x = 0; u_y = 0 on y = 0

geometry.hot_spot: quarter-circle of radius 1 mm, second material region (NOT a hole)
geometry.membrane: 20 mm x 20 mm reduced by two symmetry planes to 10 mm x 10 mm x 0.25 mm quarter model

loads.thermal: uniform thermal strain 1e-3 in the circular region, zero in the surrounding membrane (stress analysis with prescribed temperature field; no transient heat transfer)

mesh_sweep.continuity: linear C^0 spline space; NO local or hierarchical refinement
mesh_sweep.formulation_3D: constrains u_z and applies the constitutive transformation reproducing plane stress
mesh_sweep.grid: uniform 44 x 44 x 1 background grid, in-plane cell 0.227 mm

provenance.reference_doc_sections: §2 Geometry, §3 Material, §4 Loading & BC, §6 accepted solution, §7 Results (Table 1)

reference_values.source: The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks, Test T1

title: NAFEMS P18 T1 — membrane with circular hot spot (thermal strain)
